'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Echoes of Fear''''' is a [[canon]] [[2024]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[George Mann]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. The [[The High Republic Adventures – Echoes of Fear 1|first issue]] was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[September 4]], 2024.
